findings.label: Collapsed group separator relies on existing borderTop
findings.detail: When collapsed, group separation falls back to the pre-existing borderTop on the List (gi > 0) rather than a dedicated Divider; visually adequate but worth confirming it reads clearly at 64px. Cosmetic.

findings.label: Full-width board overflow risk in focus mode
findings.detail: At md:12 the Gantt/board could overflow horizontally if its inner min width exceeds the recovered space. Cosmetic, already acknowledged by the author as non-blocking.
